brief: Disclosures for Entero Therapeutics (formerly First Wave BioPharma and AzurRx BioPharma). Its stopped phase 2 trials: NCT04858425 (terminated after topline data), NCT04839575 and NCT04243551 (terminated, enrollment), NCT04542434 and NCT04436458 (withdrawn). For each, find what the company told investors in 8-Ks near the stop. Quote the 8-K language exactly and say whether it gives a reason.

findings.claim: For NCT04858425 (Phase 2 RESERVOIR trial of FW-COV), Entero Therapeutics (then First Wave BioPharma) stated in an 8-K filed on April 29, 2022: "While the top-line efficacy measure from the RESERVOIR trial did not show any anti-viral activity, the drug was well-tolerated without". This gives an efficacy and safety reason.
findings.notes: The filing specifically names the RESERVOIR trial and discusses top-line results.

findings.claim: For NCT04839575 and NCT04243551 (latiglutenase trials), searching 8-Ks matching these specific NCT IDs found no matching 8-K filings.
findings.notes: No 8-K filings specifically mention these NCT IDs.

findings.claim: For NCT04542434 and NCT04436458, searching 8-Ks matching these specific NCT IDs found no matching 8-K filings.
